item.title: [MEDIUM] SilkParasite: China-nexus Central Asia espionage with AI-assisted lures and RAT code
item.description: Bitdefender tracked seven RAT families, five new, in about 65 infections at Central Asian governments; two lures appeared AI-generated and malware such as GoginRAT carried leftover test code suggesting AI assistance. Target: Government bodies in Uzbekistan, Turkmenistan and Kazakhstan. UZ. Verification: confirmed.
